title: Lint codes never collide across branches
why: A lane picks a lint code (STALEnnn, STEnnn) on its branch that another lane or main already uses. Proven case: stale-flags used STALE003 (cef5c8e31), which main uses for the dead-path check; it was renamed by hand to STALE007 in 62fe3dc93.
note: A check, run in CI and in the merge tool's fresh-base re-check, refuses a code the branch adds that the base tip already defines, and a code defined twice in one tree. Red test first.
